description: Life Events for characters from Asim. Rolled when a career Event roll results in 'Life Event'. Roll 1D.

1.title: New Contact
1.text: You have the ear of someone at court. Pick Cleon Hardy, Rachando, Kisayl or Lord Wrax as a Contact.

2.title: Family Affairs
2.text: Roll 1D. 1-2: Your family has thrived since the reconquest. Gain SOC +1. 3-4: A Drinaxi noble killed your father during the war. Gain him as an Enemy. 5-6: Your family still live in desperate poverty on Asim. You may lose one Benefit roll to relieve some of their suffering; if you do so, gain DM+1 to your next Advancement roll.

3.title: Romantic Entanglement
3.text: Roll 1D. 1-3: Your family holds to the old ways, and you have been married off despite your objections. 4-6: You travelled to Drinax to seek your fortune, and found someone instead. Roll 1D: 1 Amicable breakup. 2 Nasty breakup — gain a Rival or Enemy. 3-4 Ongoing relationship — gain a Contact. 5 Marriage — gain an Ally [Spouse]. 6 Tragic death or disappearance.

4.title: Misfortune
4.text: You encounter difficulty. Roll 1D. 1-2: Your low-tech homeworld did not prepare you for the wider galaxy, and you run into a dangerous misunderstanding. Lose 1 Benefit roll or lose a Contact or Ally. 3-4: You are injured while travelling. Roll on the Injury table. 5-6: Aslan Slavers! You are kidnapped by slavers from the Glorious Empire. Roll 1D to see where the slavers put you: 1-2 Navy, 3-4 Army, 5-6 Scout. While enslaved, you cannot gain a Commission or Benefit rolls. You may try to escape after each term by rolling 8+ on 2D. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.

5.title: Good Fortune
5.text: Luck is on your side. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

6.title: Unusual Event
6.text: Roll 1D. 1-2: You travel in the Aslan Hierate for some time. Gain a Contact among the Aslan. 3-4: A mentor of yours is a secret member of the Foundation, and has inducted you into their conspiracy. Your mission is to spy on the court at Drinax and report back to your secret masters on Asim. If you refuse, your family will be killed. 5-6: You are psionic! Roll to test your Psionic Strength immediately, and gain DM+4 to the roll.
